# clearml_service_account (Data Source)

Looks up one ClearML Enterprise service account by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clearml_service_account" "deployment" {
  name = "deployment-agent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allow_running_as_owner` (Boolean)
- `credentials` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `role` (String)
